name: 李时珍

points.title: 童年启蒙
points.description: 李时珍出生于蕲州（今湖北蕲春县）一个医学世家。祖父是民间医生，父亲李言闻也是当地著名医者。自幼受家庭熏陶，李时珍对医药学产生了浓厚兴趣。然而，父亲希望他走科举之路，13岁时参加县试，14岁中秀才，但此后多次参加乡试均未中举。这段时期，他白天攻读经书，晚上则跟随父亲学习医药知识，奠定了坚实的医学基础。
points.descriptionEn: Li Shizhen was born in Qizhou (present-day Qichun County, Hubei) into a family of physicians. His grandfather was a folk doctor, and his father Li Yanwen was also a renowned local physician. Influenced by his family environment from a young age, Li developed a strong interest in medicine. However, his father hoped he would pursue a career in civil service examinations. At age 13, he took the county exam and became a Xiucai at 14, but failed the provincial exams multiple times. During this period, he studied Confucian classics by day and learned medicine from his father by night, laying a solid foundation for his medical career.

points.title: 弃儒从医
points.description: 在多次科举失败后，李时珍最终决定放弃仕途，专心从医。他跟随父亲在黄州府行医，积累了丰富的临床经验。在此期间，他不仅继承了家传医术，还广泛阅读历代医书，发现许多医药典籍存在错误和矛盾。特别是《本草经》等经典著作中的错误，让他意识到重新整理和修订本草学的必要性。同时，他开始收集民间药方，走访各地名医，为日后编写《本草纲目》做准备。
points.descriptionEn: After repeated failures in the civil service examinations, Li Shizhen finally decided to abandon his official career path and focus on medicine. He practiced medicine with his father in Huangzhou Prefecture, accumulating extensive clinical experience. During this time, he not only inherited the family medical knowledge but also extensively read medical books from various dynasties, discovering numerous errors and contradictions in classical medical texts. Particularly, the mistakes in ancient works like 'Shennong Ben Cao Jing' made him realize the necessity of revising and reorganizing the materia medica. Meanwhile, he began collecting folk prescriptions and visiting physicians across different regions, preparing for his later work 'Bencao Gangmu'.

points.title: 宫廷行医
points.description: 1548年，李时珍被推荐至太医院任职，担任太医吏目。在太医院的九年时间里，他有机会接触大量宫廷珍藏的医药典籍和标本，大大开阔了视野。他利用职务之便，系统研究了历代医书，特别是《神农本草经》等经典著作，并开始构思一部全面、准确的本草学著作。然而，他对官场生活感到厌倦，加之不满于当时医学界的保守风气，最终于1567年辞去太医院职务，返回家乡，专心著述。这一时期，他已收集了大量资料，为《本草纲目》的编写奠定了坚实基础。
points.descriptionEn: In 1548, Li Shizhen was recommended to serve in the Imperial Medical Academy as a physician. During his nine years at the academy, he had access to a vast collection of imperial medical books and specimens, significantly expanding his knowledge. He took advantage of his position to systematically study medical texts from various dynasties, especially classics like 'Shennong Ben Cao Jing', and began conceiving a comprehensive and accurate materia medica work. However, he grew weary of court life and was dissatisfied with the conservative atmosphere in the medical community. Finally, in 1567, he resigned from his position and returned to his hometown to focus on writing. During this period, he had already collected extensive materials, laying a solid foundation for his later work 'Bencao Gangmu'.

points.title: 著书立说
points.description: 返回家乡后，李时珍全身心投入到《本草纲目》的编写工作中。他不仅系统整理了历代医药典籍，还亲自采集药材标本，走访各地药农和医生，收集民间验方。为了确保准确性，他常常亲自尝试药物，甚至冒着生命危险验证药性。经过十多年的艰苦努力，1578年，《本草纲目》初稿完成。这部巨著收录药物1892种，附方11096则，插图1160幅，纠正了历代本草中的许多错误，建立了科学的药物分类体系，被誉为'东方药物巨典'。在此期间，他还完成了《奇经八脉考》和《濒湖脉学》等重要医学著作。
points.descriptionEn: After returning to his hometown, Li Shizhen devoted himself completely to compiling the 'Bencao Gangmu'. He systematically organized medical books from various dynasties, personally collected medicinal specimens, visited herbalists and physicians across regions, and gathered folk prescriptions. To ensure accuracy, he often personally tested drugs, even risking his life to verify their properties. After more than a decade of hard work, the first draft of 'Bencao Gangmu' was completed in 1578. This monumental work records 1,892 medicinal substances, includes 10,096 prescriptions, and contains 1,160 illustrations. It corrected many errors in previous materia medica works and established a scientific classification system for drugs, earning it the reputation of 'Oriental Medical Encyclopedia'. During this period, he also completed other important medical works such as 'Qijing Bamai Kao' and 'Binhu Mai Xue'.

points.title: 晚年贡献
points.description: 《本草纲目》完成后，李时珍继续修订完善这部巨著，并寻求出版机会。他曾多次前往南京等地，希望得到官方支持出版，但未能如愿。直到1593年李时珍去世后，这部著作才由其子李建元进献给朝廷，最终于1596年在南京首次刊印。李时珍晚年还致力于医学教育，培养了一批弟子，传播他的医学理念。他强调理论与实践相结合，重视临床经验，反对盲目崇古。1593年，李时珍在蕲州逝世，享年75岁。他的《本草纲目》不仅在中国医学史上具有里程碑意义，还对世界药物学产生了深远影响，被翻译成多种文字，流传全球。
points.descriptionEn: After completing the 'Bencao Gangmu', Li Shizhen continued to revise and perfect this monumental work, seeking opportunities for publication. He traveled to places like Nanjing multiple times, hoping to obtain official support for publication, but was unsuccessful. It was only after his death in 1593 that his son Li Jianyuan presented the work to the imperial court, and it was first published in Nanjing in 1596. In his later years, Li Shizhen was dedicated to medical education, training many disciples and spreading his medical philosophy. He emphasized the combination of theory and practice, valued clinical experience, and opposed blind reverence for ancient texts. Li Shizhen passed away in Qizhou in 1593 at the age of 75. His 'Bencao Gangmu' not only represents a milestone in Chinese medical history but also had a profound impact on world pharmacology, being translated into multiple languages and circulated globally.

supporter.zh: 李时珍被誉为'东方医药学巨匠'，他的《本草纲目》是中国医药学史上的不朽丰碑。他严谨的科学态度、勇于创新的精神和对医药学的巨大贡献，使他成为后世医家的楷模。李时珍打破了传统医学的束缚，建立了科学的药物分类体系，纠正了历代本草中的错误，为中医药学的发展奠定了坚实基础。他的著作不仅在中国流传千年，还影响了世界药物学的发展，体现了中华文明的智慧与贡献。
supporter.en: Li Shizhen is revered as the 'Giant of Eastern Medicine', and his 'Bencao Gangmu' stands as an immortal monument in the history of Chinese medicine. His rigorous scientific attitude, innovative spirit, and tremendous contributions to pharmacology have made him a model for later physicians. Li broke free from the constraints of traditional medicine, established a scientific classification system for drugs, corrected errors in previous materia medica works, and laid a solid foundation for the development of Chinese medicine. His works have not only been passed down for centuries in China but have also influenced the development of world pharmacology, reflecting the wisdom and contributions of Chinese civilization.

critic.zh: 从现代科学角度看，李时珍的研究方法存在局限性。他主要依靠文献整理和经验观察，缺乏系统的实验验证和统计分析。虽然《本草纲目》收录了大量药物，但其中一些药效描述缺乏科学依据，甚至包含一些迷信内容。此外，他对某些药物的毒性认识不足，可能导致安全隐患。李时珍未能完全突破传统医学的思维框架，其理论体系仍建立在阴阳五行等古代哲学基础上，与现代医学的实证科学方法存在差距。
critic.en: From the perspective of modern science, Li Shizhen's research methods had limitations. He primarily relied on literature review and empirical observation, lacking systematic experimental verification and statistical analysis. Although 'Bencao Gangmu' included numerous medicinal substances, some of its efficacy descriptions lacked scientific basis and even contained superstitious elements. Additionally, his understanding of the toxicity of certain drugs was insufficient, potentially posing safety risks. Li failed to completely break through the conceptual framework of traditional medicine, and his theoretical system remained based on ancient philosophies like Yin-Yang and Five Elements, creating a gap with the empirical scientific methods of modern medicine.

objective.zh: 在历史学界，李时珍被视为中国医药学集大成者，他的《本草纲目》代表了16世纪世界药物学的最高成就。在流行文化中，李时珍被塑造成医德高尚、医术精湛的典范形象，其故事被广泛传颂。现代研究表明，李时珍的贡献不仅在于药物学，还在于他开创的实证研究方法和科学分类思想，对后世科学研究产生了深远影响。他的著作跨越时空，成为连接传统与现代、东方与西方的桥梁，体现了中华文明对世界医药学的独特贡献。
objective.en: In historical scholarship, Li Shizhen is regarded as the great master of Chinese medicine, and his 'Bencao Gangmu' represents the highest achievement in world pharmacology in the 16th century. In popular culture, Li is portrayed as a model of noble medical ethics and superb medical skills, with his stories widely celebrated. Modern research indicates that Li's contributions extend beyond pharmacology to his pioneering empirical research methods and scientific classification ideas, which have had a profound impact on subsequent scientific research. His works transcend time and space, serving as a bridge connecting tradition with modernity and East with West, reflecting the unique contribution of Chinese civilization to world medicine.

self.zh: 医者，仁术也。医道之难，难在识病；医术之精，精在用药。
self.en: Medicine is the art of benevolence. The difficulty of medicine lies in recognizing diseases; the essence of medical skill lies in the use of drugs.

others.zh: 李时珍的《本草纲目》是中国医药学史上的不朽丰碑，它不仅是中国古代医药学的集大成者，也是世界药物学发展史上的重要里程碑。
others.en: Li Shizhen's 'Bencao Gangmu' is an immortal monument in the history of Chinese medicine. It is not only the culmination of ancient Chinese pharmacology but also an important milestone in the development of world pharmacology.

othersByEn: Academician of the Chinese Academy of Sciences
